title: AI Clients surfaces feature parity ledger (Web Chat, IDEs, Duo CLI)
description:
## Why

Duo's AI surfaces ship on separate tracks: Web Chat, the IDEs (VS Code, JetBrains), and Duo CLI each build new features all the time, and features regularly land on one surface without a plan to reach the others.

On top of that, the IDEs are rolling out a new UI ([Duo Agent Platform UI in IDE v2](https://gitlab.com/groups/gitlab-org/editor-extensions/-/epics/241)) that will coexist with the current UI for a transition period (users can opt in/out). During that window every new IDE feature needs an explicit decision: **old UI, new UI, or both**.

## What this epic is

A **ledger**: a single place to collect initiatives that shipped (or are shipping) on one surface and should be copied to the rest. It is not a delivery epic — it exists so cross-surface gaps don't fall through the cracks.

## How to use it

If you're working on a feature on one surface that should also exist on others:

1. **Add a child item here.** Minimal is fine, a couple of sentences is enough.
2. **Link your work stream** (the epic/issue/MRs where the feature is actually being built).

That's it. we can more details or actual child implementation issues when we pick up the effort

- [Duo Agent Platform UI in IDE v2](https://gitlab.com/groups/gitlab-org/editor-extensions/-/epics/241) — the dual-UI transition driving old/new/both decisions
